function: Diffusion model reconstructs the target's EM property point cloud (shape, permittivity, conductivity) from the estimated sensing channel (pp. 1, 5-8); not one of the seven areas.
notes: Excluded as function (pp. 1, 3, 5-9). The only learned component is the diffusion model, made of a channel transferring network and a noise estimating network (p. 8), that reconstructs the EM property point cloud from the estimated sensing channel (pp. 5-6). The sensing channel is estimated by least squares (p. 3) and the ISAC beamforming is CRB minimization solved by SDR with CVX (p. 9), so no learned model designs beams, waveforms, or resources (area 5), and no other area applies. PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (arXiv:2407.03075, 20 Oct 2024). If the reviewer counts learned sensing inside an ISAC system as area 5: simulated data (ShapeNet targets, p. 10), no baseline compared, 0.24 s runtime per target (p. 11).
